correction: Initial C input appended a newline and terminator while the candidate input did not. Preserved initial raw evidence. Corrected component feeds the exact same appended source to both implementations; this is a corrected harness replay, not a replay of identical candidate input.
algorithm_fix: For ordinary tables use the closing parenthesis offset. For table options retain all source trivia up to semicolon or EOF, matching sqlite3EndTable. Component TEMP/STRICT/WITHOUT ROWID coverage is not Core admission.

eof_component.oracle_invocation: sqlite3 receives source SQL and observation SQL as separate arguments, so EOF is real and neither implementation receives observation text.

proof_scope: CoreSQL.execute remains the AST command-trace model. CoreSourceSQL.executeStatement adds schema-checked catalog source and is the production file boundary. retain_effect links its successful metadata update to unchanged rows/schema/indexes/other tables.
